name: hud-bridge
description: Shows other extensions' pick lists and text boxes (showQuickPick / showInputBox) in the AI HUD when it's running, e.g. abap-fs asking for a transport request. Falls back to the normal pop-up when the HUD is closed.

hudBridge.enabled.description: Show other extensions' pick lists and text boxes in the AI HUD while it's running.

commands.title: AI HUD bridge: Show which extensions are bridged
